digest.component_or_area: configuration schema and LLM overlap detection
propositions: verify.overlap_enabled is misleadingly named after its internal mechanism rather than its user-visible output (duplicate-ticket link suggestions), causing operators to misclassify it as a blocking gate.
The config key is undocumented in docs/config.md (zero occurrences of 'overlap') despite being an opt-in feature that scales cost with tracker size, limiting operator visibility.

The field must be renamed to verify.suggest_duplicate_tickets and made the canonical name while maintaining permanent aliases for both the TOML key and environment variable to preserve existing project configs.
Both the legacy TOML key and legacy environment variable must be honored via permanent-alias machinery (_ALIASES and _LEGACY_ENV_ALIASES entries with registry rows marked _permanent, not _scheduled).
A new docs/config.md entry must document the setting's output (link suggestions), its three processing stages, its advisory nature, its cost scaling, and its algorithm tunables.

When both legacy and canonical keys are present (TOML or environment), the canonical value must win with no warning; the golden config surface must carry both old and new names accounted for as aliases.
